# MetaForge for claude.ai

**Generated by `scripts/build_integrations.py` — do not edit by hand.**

The same skills and commands as `claude-code/`, with the connector already pointing at the hosted gateway (`https://mcp.metaforge.uk/mcp`). There is nothing to configure: install it, and claude.ai asks you to sign in the first time it connects.

## Install

In claude.ai, **Customize → Plugins → Add → Add marketplace**, enter `FidelOdok/MetaForge`, and install `metaforge-cloud`.

Choose **Connect** on the plugin's connector. A MetaForge sign-in page opens; enter the access secret your administrator gave you. claude.ai keeps the token it gets back, so you sign in once.

## Which package

| | `metaforge-cloud` | `metaforge` | `metaforge-local` |
|---|---|---|---|
| For | claude.ai, hosted gateway | Claude Code, any gateway | Claude Code, no gateway |
| Connector | filled in for you | asks for a URL | a local process |

Install **one**. The manifest has no way to switch a server entry off, so two packages would offer every tool twice.

Using your own gateway rather than the hosted one? Install `metaforge` and give it your URL instead.

## Writes wait for a human

A tool that writes is held for approval, because the hosted gateway sees you as a remote caller. Held calls appear on the dashboard's Approvals page.
